card.name: Sentence-opening Once, When, For, To
card.fires_on: The first word of a new sentence or clause that opens a subordinate or purpose phrase, such as Once, When, For or To. It appears in explanatory prose about how something works.

modes.label: Once/When opening a process step
modes.description: A temporal conjunction starts a sentence describing what happens next in a process.
modes.example: <<Once>> Dell receives your encrypted personal information, we

modes.label: For/To opening a purpose phrase
modes.description: For or To starts a sentence giving a purpose or a specific group.
modes.example: <<For>> people with COPD, the test measures

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the word that begins a new explanatory sentence, such as Once or When, just before the subject is named.
